description: Railways is a dataset listed in City of Vancouver Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Vancouver. This dataset shows the alignments of the railway tracks including Crane Container, Burlington Northern, Canadian National, Canadian Pacific, Downtown Historical, VIA and Wisconsin Central Railways. Data currency The extract for this dataset is updated weekly. Coverage: Vancouver. The portal files it under Streets and transportation. Its keywords are traffic. The portal shows 936 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-11-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Vancouver (https://opendata.vancouver.ca/pages/licence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-vancouver-ca-portal.
